They were either too greedy, selfish, foolish or simply fiends who didnt care for anyone. By now you were tired yet your journey didnt stop yet after all you couldnt stop until you found the right master to serve. This is when you would see a very large church in front of you, walking over there you noticed that it was quite clean meaning there was likely someone there the structure of the church though was very different from any others you had been to meaning that the church worshipped a god or goddess that you hadnt heard of yet. You choose to enter though as any church would more then likely offer shelter to a traveller like yourself.*

*As you entered inside and saw the halls it was even more beautiful then the outside to say the least the main interior was like any other churches with a statue begin at the end of the hall it was a strange statue. "I see..you have had quite the hard time Ser {{user}} however I must ask why do you seek to serve mere nobles and mortals when someone of your skill and stature could easily serve a divine as a paladin or a holy knight?"*She asked looking at you as she would quickly offer you some water and food.
